# Palletways UK

Palletways UK is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Palletways is Europe's most trusted pallet delivery network, offering full tracking, award-winning service and unrivalled coverage. Palletways UK employs 239 people (+6.7% YoY, +15 people), founded in 1994. Headquartered in Lichfield, Staffordshire, United Kingdom, with offices in Livingstone, Greenford, Milton Keynes, and Leeds. Its workforce is distributed across United Kingdom, Ireland, Italy, and United States.

## About

The UK arm of Europe's largest palletised freight network, trusted by many and rated Excellent on Trustpilot ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Founded in Lichfield in 1994, Palletways has grown to become Europe’s most trusted palletised freight network, offering efficient and reliable solutions for transporting goods both domestically and across Europe. In the UK, our network is made up of over 130 independent pallet delivery companies who provide outstanding service nationwide.

We operate a hub-and-spoke distribution model, designed to be both efficient and sustainable, reducing overall mileage and minimising empty vehicle space to ensure smarter pallet deliveries.

Our focus is on making pallet shipping as simple and dependable as possible, backed by innovative technology, a highly experienced team and a commitment to customer service that sets us apart.

For one-off pallet shipping quotes visit: www.palletwaysonline.com

# Palletways Group Ltd

Palletways Group Ltd is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Palletways is Europe's most trusted pallet delivery network, offering full tracking, award-winning service and unrivalled coverage. Palletways Group Ltd employs 148 people (+0.7% YoY, +1 person) and has an annual revenue of $237M, founded in 1994. Headquartered in United Kingdom. Its workforce is distributed across 7 countries (including United Kingdom, Spain, Italy, Netherlands, and Switzerland).

## About

Palletways is Europe’s largest provider of express palletised distribution services. With our strategically positioned network of depots and hub operations, we’re unrivalled in our ability to connect your business to the whole of Europe.

Our network comprises of over 400 depots across Europe, owned and operated by independent logistics companies. Together with our 17 hubs in 20 countries, we combine our resources to deliver goods faster and more cost effectively than ever.

Innovation and technology is key to our success. Through the development of core IT systems, members and customers have total control of their supply chain, from collection to delivery. We regularly win awards for Service Excellence and Innovation. Our recent developments include archway vehicle scanning, real-time information portal and most recently the launch of our online booking system at palletwaysonline.com, allowing easy and convenient access to our services.

Together with our members, our vision is to be the European network of natural choice for the distribution of palletised freight.

  >
  > 5 steps to wrap a pallet properly:
  > 1. Wrap individual items first
  > 2. Stack centrally, heavy at bottom
  > 3. Wrap from base up, 50% overlap

properties.description:
Palletways is Europe’s largest provider of express palletised distribution services. With our strategically positioned network of depots and hub operations, we’re unrivalled in our ability to connect your business to the whole of Europe.

Our network comprises of over 400 depots across Europe, owned and operated by independent logistics companies. Together with our 17 hubs in 20 countries, we combine our resources to deliver goods faster and more cost effectively than ever.

Innovation and technology is key to our success. Through the development of core IT systems, members and customers have total control of their supply chain, from collection to delivery. We regularly win awards for Service Excellence and Innovation. Our recent developments include archway vehicle scanning, real-time information portal and most recently the launch of our online booking system at palletwaysonline.com, allowing easy and convenient access to our services.

Together with our members, our vision is to be the European network of natural choice for the distribution of palletised freight.
